name: Kuramori Masaki
source:
"Your aptitude is off the charts! How delightful! We have a new member!"

A chemistry teacher at Oceanside Elite Academy.

In truth, he's the commander of the special forces known as the Blooms. The group follows orders from the research district.

He often teases people, much to the chagrin of the Blooms members. He refuses to alter his behavior, however.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
